payload.reason: The evidence provides a comparison of the method's performance against baseline models, specifically the standard Transformer architecture using softmax and the novel 1.5-entmax model.

claims.text: Replacing softmax with entmax does not hurt performance; sparse attention Transformers tend to have slightly higher BLEU scores.
The models using α-entmax and 1.5-entmax achieve 75% and 90% of the training speed of the softmax model, respectively.
The α-entmax model learns different sparsity patterns at each layer, leading to more variance in individual head behavior compared to fixed α models.
